title: Chapter 782
paragraphs: Chapter 782
Episode 192. Three Days Ago (3)
The Sword Garden.
A large explosion had occurred in the Tower of Tales, presumably due to a battle. Moreover, the sky around the tower had darkened as if night had fallen after the explosion.
That was all the information reported about the incident that occurred in the Lutero Federation three days ago. There was no explanation at all about who exactly had been fighting.
Naturally, the Zipfel were thoroughly hiding the incident. If the spies who infiltrated the Federation had not confirmed it, Runcandel would not have known about the explosion in the Tower of Tales.
"Tell the spies in the Federation to withdraw immediately. Veradin also has an ability similar to a recording magic, so if such an event occurs, he will definitely scour the surroundings."
"Yes, fortunately, the spies have already started to withdraw in anticipation of this. They're quick, they won't get caught."
"That's a relief. Steward, as soon as the spies return, reward them handsomely."
[Understood.]
"A battle. Your Excellency. Kadun has been causing a lot of trouble, could this be related?"
"It's definitely an internal problem, Brother Heitona. The only forces capable of assaulting the Tower of Tales are us and Kinzelo, but there were no suspicious movements from the Kinzelo side."
[We cannot rule out the possibility that Veradin Zipfel, who recently became the Excellency, and Hualong Kadun were at odds.]

"That's possible. But the Tower of Tales is, well, like the heart of Zipfel. It's strange that the battle took place there of all places. If our spies, who were quite a distance away from the Tower of Tales, could observe it, it was a large-scale battle."
The sky near the tower darkened like night after the explosion....
Jin was focusing on that phrase.

'Given the battle in the magic tower, it's quite possible that various grand magics overlapped and cast shadows in the sky. Assuming that the devil's stone was used, its unique spirit could darken the sky.'
But he had a strange sense of incongruity, as if there was something more.
-So far, Runcandel did not know exactly how Zipfel was manipulating history.
They only understood that manipulation occurred after Zipfel's magicians flocked to the Tower of Tales in large numbers.
Information confirmed at Temar's third tomb.

'The Tower of Tales is a core space for historical manipulation according to the records from Solderet's device... And it's the domain of the Zipfel Lord. Plus, Kadun is an entity that would never betray Zipfel. Even if he really opposed Veradin, there would be no reason to choose that place as the battlefield.'
Given that Zipfel was already suffering from the weakened power of history manipulation, there was no reason to create a situation that could cause problems at the Tower of Tales.
Above all, the Tower of Tales was also the strongest fortress within Zipfel. The Tower of Tales was presumed to be harder to capture than Dracabo, where Zipfel's home was.

'Kadun, or anyone else for that matter, starting a battle for rebellion in the Tower of Tales is crazy. It's too difficult to occupy the Tower of Tales, and even if they win, the damage would be too great if the tower is damaged.'

Of course, if Kadun was as Jin knew him, he could run amok without controlling his temper. However, upon careful consideration, Kadun had always backed down when he realized he was in a disadvantageous situation. It had been the case during several quarrels with Jin and when he was in a fight with Zephyrine.
"Such a scene where Kadun risked his life to fight Veradin to the death at the Tower of Tales was hard to imagine.
'Then we have to assume there was a fight that Kadun could never back away from. The only reason that could justify it is...'
Kelliark Zipfel.

Suddenly, his name and status flashed through his mind. Kelliark Zipfel, the head of the Zipfel family, who is in a vegetative state due to the erosion of his spirit and is being kept alive in the maintenance facility on the top floor of the magic tower.
At the same time, two hypotheses came to mind.
'...What if Veradin tried to kill Kelliark Zipfel? If Kadun was the protagonist of the battle, then he couldn't possibly retreat.'
Jin explained his thoughts.

[The heir to the Zipfel family, trying to kill the current head of the family... Hmm, the heir always said that Veradin Zipfel was a righteous and upright person until he was manipulated. He also had a strong aversion to the family.]

'But looking at Veradin Zipfel's recent behavior, it doesn't seem like his sanity has returned. If we assume that Veradin tried to kill Kelliark, the only scenario we can think of is that Veradin pushed Kelliark out to seize power. And that would only be possible if Kelliark was already in a situation where he couldn't fight back, or else.'
Mary's eyes widened at this point.
'...Rampage. If Kelliark caused a rampage, like the devil did, it's a plausible story. The part about the sky turning black, that could also be due to the spirit, not the magic.'
Mary added the second part.

Jin was thinking the same thing. If Kelliark, who was eroded by his spirit, had caused a rampage, that would certainly explain the large-scale battle at the Tower of Tales. The Zipfels would have no choice but to suppress Kelliark.
'And if Kelliark really did go on a rampage, it wouldn't be unrelated to Lokia Ganesto. Lord Fadler was sure that Lokia Ganesto was involved in the birth of the devil.'
There was a moment of silence.
What Jin said implied that another entity like the devil could be born, not in Runcandel, but in Zipfel.
'Neither Zipfel nor anyone else would want another devil-like entity to be born. Zipfel wants to rule, not to destroy.'
[So you're saying the battle at the Tower of Tales could be the result of trying to intervene before Kelliark became something similar to a devil.]
'Of course, these are all assumptions, and there's nothing definitive. We'll have to see for ourselves.'
[Are you saying you're going to go see it yourself?]
'Yes. I think it would be a good idea to assemble an elite infiltration team, including myself, to examine the records near the Tower of Tales.'

[Unlike spies, you won't be in danger of death, even in enemy territory. Especially if the elite infiltration team includes Miss Yona and the Nameless King. However, if we are discovered, it could escalate into a sensitive issue.]

'Even if we're discovered, we're not without justification. If another devil is suspected to appear, Zipfel can't strongly deny it. If they could wage war simply because they're displeased, they should have done so already.'
'True, there's no rule saying that Zipfel isn't planning to use Kelliark as a devil-like entity. It's a matter that needs to be looked into for sure. Spying on each other is a public secret anyway.'
[Understood. Shall I contact the Nameless King immediately
and prepare?]

'Please do. The infiltration will take place in a week. In the meantime, try to find out as much as you can about Kadun's location and condition, as well as the movements of the Zipfel leadership, including Veradin.'
[Yes, Your Lordship.]
Lutero Magic Federation, the Sanctuary Gate.
"Arghhh…!"
For three days now, someone's screams had not ceased in the treatment room inside the gate.
It was Veradin's scream. Ronil and Octavia paced anxiously in front of the treatment room, their faces grim.
"Ah, Ronil. Can the Master really recover like this?"

Octavia spoke. She was looking at the biogolems entering the treatment room at an interval of one hour since Veradin arrived. They were the same biogolems that Jin had seen when he came to recover Valeria in the past.
"I don't know very well either. The priestess said the treatment will be over soon, so let's wait."
"The priestess, who exactly is she? Why has she been kept secret from me all this time? Did the Master also know about her?"
"That's not something I can tell you. When the Master wakes up, ask him directly."

Octavia felt like she was going mad from frustration. Even though she had seen the fact that Kadun was a traitor, and that Kelliark had caused a rampage, there were still too many parts she couldn't understand.
Therefore, Octavia still doubted Veradin. She suspected that Kadun's betrayal and Kelliark's rampage were part of Veradin's scheme to seize power.
But one thing was clear.

The abilities that Veradin displayed in the battle three days ago exceeded Kelliark's prime. If Veradin had not been there, Kelliark, in a state of rampage with his soul, and the fire dragon Kadun would have brought down the Tower of Tales in one breath. Veradin certainly had the power to fill Kadun's vacancy and more.
The intensity of that battle was such that everyone, except Veradin and the guardian dragons, had no choice but to leave the battlefield in the latter half.
After three more hours passed, the screams from inside the treatment room finally stopped.
And Veradin who came out of the treatment room was perfectly fine without any injuries.
'The Master lost both arms in the battle three days ago and his heart was pierced. It was an irreversible level without the use of Numerus's tears, but what in the world…'
When Octavia made eye contact with Veradin, she inadvertently lowered her head. It was chilling as if he was still seeing through her.
"Brother Ronil."
Veradin, as if nothing had happened, immediately gave orders.
"Speak."
"Jin Runcandel will soon visit the scene. He'll bring the record wizard."
"How should we respond?"

"Do nothing. If Jin Runcandel does not come within a week, subtly leak information about the battle at the Tower of Tales to Runcandel. I'm curious what information the record wizard will find there."
"Understood."
"Where are Tuyan and Pinia?"
"Since that day, the two dragons have continued to investigate the battlefield. They mentioned that it's not easy to approach because of the remaining soul."
Upon hearing Ronil's response, Veradin narrowed his eyebrows and added this afterthought.
"…If Tuyan and Pinia are still looking around there, it means Father's death has not been confirmed yet."
